dimensions.assessment: Affects passenger rail entities and parties involved in liability determinations subject to the statutory rail passenger liability cap in 2026.
dimensions.evidence: rail passenger liability cap that occurs during calendar year 2026

dimensions.assessment: Modifies only the timing of the effective date for an inflation-based liability cap adjustment rather than altering underlying liability rules permanently.
dimensions.evidence: adjust the effective date of any adjustment based on Consumer Price Index to rail passenger liability cap

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are stated or implied by shifting the effective date of the liability cap adjustment.
Narrowly targets the effective date mechanism for a specific statutory liability cap adjustment occurring in a single calendar year.
dimensions.evidence: The effective date for any adjustment to the liability cap... that occurs during calendar year 2026, shall be 90 days after the notice

dimensions.assessment: The adjustment is restricted specifically to changes occurring during calendar year 2026.

missing_information: The exact dollar amount of the Consumer Price Index adjustment to the liability cap is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 5697 adjusts the effective date for any Consumer Price Index-based adjustment to the rail passenger liability cap occurring during calendar year 2026 to be 90 days after notice.
